description: Error Reporting - Add crash and error tracking capabilities to Aptabase for all platforms (Web, Mobile, Desktop) with PII sanitization and dedicated dashboard

userStories.title: Database schema for error storage
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a database schema to store error events separately from analytics events.
acceptanceCriteria: Create new ClickHouse/Tinybird table for error events with fields: error_id, app_id, timestamp, error_message, error_type, stack_trace, platform, os_name, os_version, app_version, sdk_version, session_id
Set TTL to 180 days for error data retention
Add migration for PostgreSQL to track error quotas/limits per app
Migration runs successfully on both ClickHouse and Tinybird backends
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Completed - Created ClickHouse migration 0005-error_events.sql and PostgreSQL migration 0013_AddErrorTracking.cs

userStories.title: Error ingestion API endpoint
userStories.description: As an SDK developer, I need an API endpoint to send error/crash data from client applications.
acceptanceCriteria: Create POST /api/v0/error endpoint that accepts error payloads
Validate required fields (app_id, timestamp, error_message, error_type)
Store errors in in-memory buffer similar to event ingestion pattern
Return 202 Accepted on successful ingestion
Apply rate limiting (use existing EventIngestion policy: 20 req/sec per IP)
Typecheck passes
Test with curl/Postman to verify ingestion works
userStories.notes: Completed - Created ErrorsController with POST /api/v0/error endpoint, ErrorBody validation, InMemoryErrorBuffer, and test script

userStories.title: PII sanitization for errors
userStories.description: As a privacy-conscious platform, I need to automatically sanitize PII from error messages and stack traces.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement sanitization function that redacts: emails, IP addresses, API keys/tokens, credit card numbers, phone numbers
Apply sanitization to error_message and stack_trace before storage
Use regex patterns for common PII formats
Preserve stack trace structure while redacting values
Add unit tests for sanitization function
All tests pass
userStories.notes: Completed - Created IPiiSanitizer and PiiSanitizer with comprehensive regex patterns, applied in ErrorsController, added 34 unit tests

userStories.title: Background worker for error persistence
userStories.description: As a system, I need to flush buffered errors to the database periodically to ensure data persistence.
acceptanceCriteria: Create ErrorBackgroundWriter similar to EventBackgroundWriter
Flush errors every 5 seconds or when buffer reaches 1000 errors
Write to ClickHouse or Tinybird based on configuration
Log errors if write fails but don't crash the service
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Completed - Created ErrorBackgroundWritter, ErrorRow, IErrorIngestionClient with ClickHouse and Tinybird implementations

userStories.title: Query service for retrieving errors
userStories.description: As a backend developer, I need a query service to retrieve errors from the database for API endpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: Create IErrorQueryClient interface with methods: GetErrors, GetErrorById, GetErrorCount
Implement for both ClickHouse and Tinybird
Support filtering by: app_id, date range, error_type, platform
Support pagination (offset/limit)
Return errors ordered by timestamp DESC
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Completed - Created IErrorQueryClient interface with GetErrorsAsync, GetErrorByIdAsync, and GetErrorCountAsync methods. Implemented ClickHouseErrorQueryClient and TinybirdErrorQueryClient with support for filtering by app_id, date range, error_type, platform, and pagination.
